test_manager_is_singleton: test that get_manager returns the same MCPOAuthManager instance across multiple calls
test_manager_get_or_build_provider_cache: test that get_or_build_provider returns the same provider instance when called twice with the same server name and URL
test_manager_get_or_build_rebuilds_on_ur: test that get_or_build_provider creates a new provider when the server URL changes
test_manager_remove_evicts_cache: test that remove evicts the provider from cache and deletes the associated disk token files
test_disk_watch_invalidates_on_mtime_cha: test that invalidate_if_disk_changed returns True when the token file mtime changes and resets provider initialization
